tagline.en: NVIDIA Cosmos3 — a joint-modality world model spanning image, video, synchronized sound, and robot action, in Nano and Super sizes.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA Cosmos3——覆盖图像、视频、同步音频与机器人动作的联合模态世界模型,提供 Nano 与 Super 两种规模。

en: Cosmos3 is the broadest world model in NVIDIA's Cosmos family, a joint-modality generator that unifies visual, audio, and action generation. It handles text-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video, can produce synchronized sound, and exposes structured action inference — policy, forward dynamics, and inverse dynamics — for physical-AI and embodied use cases.

It comes in Nano and Super sizes, both released under the OpenMDW-1.1 license and non-gated. Internally it combines a joint-modality runner and shared loader with a Karras flow-UniPC scheduler, a shared Wan VAE for visual decoding, and an inference-only AVAE decoder for sound.

In WorldFoundry, base Cosmos3 routes to the Nano checkpoint, and you select the Super variant for the larger model. It runs as an inference-only recipe; the upstream reasoner, guardrail, and serving stacks are orchestration extensions kept outside this generator.
zh: Cosmos3 是 NVIDIA Cosmos 家族中覆盖面最广的世界模型,一个统一视觉、音频与动作生成的联合模态生成器。它支持文生图、文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频,可生成同步音频,并提供结构化的动作推理——策略、前向动力学与逆向动力学——面向物理 AI 与具身场景。
它提供 Nano 与 Super 两种规模,均以 OpenMDW-1.1 许可发布且无使用门槛。其内部由联合模态 runner 与共享加载器,配合 Karras flow-UniPC 调度器、用于视觉解码的共享 Wan VAE,以及仅推理的 AVAE 音频解码器组成。
在 WorldFoundry 中,基础 Cosmos3 选择会路由到 Nano checkpoint,选择 Super 变体则使用更大的模型。它作为仅推理的方案运行;上游的 reasoner、护栏与服务栈属于编排扩展,不包含在该生成器内。

whenToUse.en: When you want a single world model that spans image, video, optional synchronized sound, and robot action inference (policy, forward and inverse dynamics), with an openly-licensed, non-gated checkpoint.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个横跨图像、视频、可选同步音频与机器人动作推理(策略、前向与逆向动力学)的统一世界模型,并使用开放许可、无门槛的 checkpoint 时。

notFor.en: This is the inference-only generator; safety screening, the reasoner, and serving workflows are separate orchestration layers. Pick Nano for lighter runs and Super when you need the larger model.
notFor.zh: 这是仅推理的生成器;安全审查、reasoner 与服务流程属于独立的编排层。轻量运行选 Nano,需要更大模型时选 Super。

en: Joint-modality world model: image, video, sound, and action
Structured policy, forward-dynamics, and inverse-dynamics inference
Nano and Super sizes, non-gated, OpenMDW-1.1 license
Optional synchronized sound via an AVAE decoder
zh: 联合模态世界模型:图像、视频、音频与动作
结构化的策略、前向动力学与逆向动力学推理
Nano 与 Super 两种规模,无门槛,OpenMDW-1.1 许可
可选的同步音频(经 AVAE 解码器)
